description: This file is a minified JavaScript source code for 'Material Design for Bootstrap 4' library (MDB). It includes licensing info, documentation links, and references to external libraries like jQuery, Chart.js, Velocity, etc. It also contains implementations of easing functions, velocity code, and color manipulation utilities. The code is meant to be included as part of a web project, providing UI components, animations, and other features.

classes.name: Element
classes.description: A fundamental graphical element with support for interpolation, pivoting, and transition animations, used throughout MDB for visual components.

classes.name: canvas
classes.description: A collection of static canvas drawing utilities provided in the 'Chart.helpers.canvas' namespace.

methods.name: interpolate
methods.description: Interpolates between start, view, and model objects for smooth animations, including support for color and number transitions.

methods.name: Element.prototype.initialize
methods.description: Initializes the element with default properties and prepares it for animations and rendering.

methods.name: Element.prototype.pivot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of the current model state to enable smooth transitioning animations.

methods.name: Element.prototype.transition
methods.description: Transitions the element's view towards the model values based on an easing factor.

methods.name: Element.prototype.tooltipPosition
methods.description: Returns the current position of the element for tooltip placement.

methods.name: Element.prototype.hasValue
methods.description: Checks whether the element has valid x and y model values.

methods.name: roundedRect
methods.description: Creates a rounded rectangle path with specified corner radius.

methods.name: drawPoint
methods.description: Draws various point styles (circle, triangle, rect, star, etc.) at specified position.

methods.name: clipArea
methods.description: Sets a clipping rectangle area on the canvas context.

methods.name: unclipArea
methods.description: Restores the canvas context from clipping.

methods.name: lineTo
methods.description: Draws a line or bezier curve between points, supporting stepped lines.

methods.name: each
methods.description: Iterates over an array or object, calling a provided function for each element or property.

methods.name: arrayEquals
methods.description: Compares two arrays (possibly nested) for content equality.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of arrays and objects.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Recursively merges properties from source objects into a target object.

methods.name: mergeIf
methods.description: Merges only undefined properties from source into target.

methods.name: extend
methods.description: Applies properties from multiple objects into a target object.

methods.name: inherits
methods.description: Creates a class inheritance structure similar to Backbone.js.

methods.name: callback
methods.description: Invokes a callback, optionally with a given context.

methods.name: requestAnimFrame
methods.description: Requests an animation frame, used for smooth animations.

methods.name: getStyle
methods.description: Retrieves computed style property from a DOM element.

methods.name: getRelativePosition
methods.description: Calculates mouse or touch position relative to a chart canvas.

methods.name: fontString
methods.description: Constructs a CSS font string from size, style, and family.

methods.name: valueOrDefault
methods.description: Returns the first defined value among inputs, used for fallback defaults.

methods.name: isNullOrUndef
methods.description: Checks if a value is null or undefined.

methods.name: toLineHeight
methods.description: Converts a line height value to pixels based on font size.

methods.name: IDMatches
methods.description: Function appearing in scale components to match dataset meta IDs for axes.

methods.name: generateTicks
methods.description: Generates tick values for linear and logarithmic scales based on options and data range.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Creates timestamp ticks for time scale, with support for minor/major units and alignment.

methods.name: buildLookupTable
methods.description: Constructs a lookup table to interpolate between time values and positions.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Performs a binary search within the lookup table to find bounds for interpolation.

methods.name: interpolate
methods.description: Interpolates a value between two entries in the lookup table.

methods.name: momentify
methods.description: Converts a value into a moment object, using custom parsing or format if provided.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an input value into a timestamp, considering options like rounding.

methods.name: determineStepSize
methods.description: Calculates optimal step size for ticks based on min/max range and capacity.

methods.name: determineUnitForAutoTicks
methods.description: Chooses appropriate time unit for auto-generated ticks.

methods.name: determineUnitForFormatting
methods.description: Selects the best time unit to format axis labels based on tick count and range.

methods.name: determineMajorUnit
methods.description: Returns the next larger time unit for major tick marks.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Creates an array of timestamp ticks between min and max with aligned units.

methods.name: computeOffsets
methods.description: Calculates left and right offsets to position time ticks accurately within the scale.

methods.name: ticksFromTimestamps
methods.description: Creates tick objects from timestamp values, marking major ticks.

methods.name: determineLabelFormat
methods.description: Selects date formatting string based on the data to display appropriate detail.

methods.name: getPointLabelFontOptions
methods.description: Calculates font attributes for point labels in radial scales.

methods.name: measureLabelSize
methods.description: Measures width and height of radial point labels.

methods.name: determineLimits
methods.description: Calculates positional bounds for labels around a radial chart to prevent overlap.

methods.name: fitWithPointLabels
methods.description: Adjusts the radius of a radial scale to accommodate point labels without overlap.

methods.name: fit
methods.description: Sets the maximum radius for a radial scale when no labels are present.

methods.name: getTextAlignForAngle
methods.description: Returns appropriate text alignment based on label angle.

methods.name: fillText
methods.description: Draws text or array of lines at a specified position on canvas.

methods.name: adjustPointPositionForLabelHeight
methods.description: Modifies label position based on its height and angle to prevent overlap.

methods.name: drawPointLabels
methods.description: Renders point labels and angle lines for radial scales.

methods.name: drawRadiusLine
methods.description: Draws concentric or radial lines in radial scales.

methods.name: numberOrZero
methods.description: Utility that returns a number or zero if the input is not a number, used in radius calculations.

methods.name: setReductions
methods.description: Calculates radius reductions to fit all labels within the radial chart without overlap.

methods.name: setCenterPoint
methods.description: Defines the center point of a radial chart based on radius adjustments.

methods.name: getIndexAngle
methods.description: Returns the angle for a given point index on the radial scale.

methods.name: getDistanceFromCenterForValue
methods.description: Calculates radial distance for a data value.

methods.name: getPointPosition
methods.description: Calculates x,y position for a point at a specific index and radius.

methods.name: getPointPositionForValue
methods.description: Calculates position for a specific data value.

methods.name: getBasePosition
methods.description: Returns center position for the scale, considering zero or min/max.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Renders the complete radial scale, including tick labels, point labels, and grid lines.
